tax.title: Tax report {year}
tax.subtitle: Basis for the Czech income tax return: sales of securities and crypto, foreign dividends, interest.
tax.disclaimer: The report is an indicative basis, not tax advice. It uses the transactions in the app (FIFO) and the Czech Income Tax Act rules; verify it before filing. Manually valued positions (Portu, savings accounts) are not included in sales.
tax.cap_exceeded: Income exempt under the holding test exceeded the CZK 40,000,000 cap — the exemption is reduced proportionally.

notes.under_limit: Total proceeds {amount} did not exceed CZK 100,000 — all sales are exempt.
notes.over_limit: Total proceeds {amount} exceeded CZK 100,000 — only lots held longer than 3 years are exempt.
notes.no_crypto_exemption: The crypto exemption applies to sales from 15 Feb 2025 — everything is taxable in this year.
notes.before_crypto_exemption: Sales until 14 Feb 2025 are taxable and do not count towards the CZK 100,000 limit.
notes.loss: A loss is not carried forward or offset against other income — the base is 0.
notes.securities: All securities are one type of income — gains and losses within the year offset each other.
notes.crypto: All crypto-assets are one type of income — they are not combined with securities.
notes.fee_skipped: Some sale has a fee in another crypto asset (e.g. BNB) — it has no CNB rate, so it is missing from expenses. You can claim it manually at its CZK value.

dividends.empty: No foreign dividends in this year.
dividends.note: Country by ISIN (issuer domicile). The foreign tax credit is capped at 15 % of the gross dividend; the tax treaty may set it lower. Basis for annex no. 3.
dividends.domestic: Czech dividends {amount} are taxed at source and are not reported.

interest.title: Interest
interest.note: Interest from Czech bank accounts is taxed at source by the bank and is not reported. Informational overview.

api.intro: The API returns and accepts JSON. Send the token in the Authorization header; create one in the Tokens tab.
api.rule_scope: Scope read is enough for reading (GET); writing (POST, PUT, DELETE) needs a read_write token.
api.rule_numbers: Amounts, prices and quantities are decimal strings ("1250.50"), never floating-point numbers.
api.rule_errors: Errors return {'{'}"error": {'{'}"code", "message", "fields"{'}'}{'}'} — fields only for validation (400).
api.rule_limit: Limit of {n} requests per minute per token (X-RateLimit-* headers; 429 when exceeded).
api.try_hint: Calls the endpoint with your browser sign-in (not a token) — the result is the same as with a read_write token.
api.invalid_json: Invalid JSON in an object parameter.

filing.attachment2_note: Each income type on its own table row; for foreign-source income add code “z” in column 5 (check for sales via a foreign broker). A loss of one type does not offset another.
filing.attachment4_note: Rows 401, 402–405 and 407–408 stay empty (other income). The dividends then do not go to row 38.
filing.attachment3_note: Rows 324–329 are computed by EPO / Moje daně from the whole return (credit coefficient from rows 42 and 57). Row 322 (expenses) is not used for dividends. Each further country on a separate sheet of attachment 3.

warnings.unverified_year: Row numbers are verified against the forms for 2023–2025. For {year}, check them against the current form.
warnings.crypto_code: The attachment 2 instructions do not list a code for crypto assets; C — sale of movable things is commonly used. Check with an advisor or the current instructions.
warnings.dividend_country_unknown: Some dividend has no country (instrument without ISIN) — add the ISIN, otherwise the country is “??”.
warnings.interest: Interest from foreign accounts (e.g. at a broker) is also § 8 income and belongs with dividends (row 401a / row 38) — the report cannot tell domestic (withheld) and foreign interest apart, check the Interest section.
warnings.cap_exceeded: Exempt income exceeded CZK 40 million — part is taxable; the guide accounts for it, but verify it with an advisor.

filing.advisor_intro: An advisor needs the summary below and the per-lot sales detail (CSV) to verify acquisition costs and the holding test.

advisor.crypto: Crypto assets: taxable income {income}, expenses {expense}; exempt {exempt}.
advisor.domestic: Czech dividends: {total} — taxed by withholding, not reported.

filing.advisor_note: Printing the whole page (Print button above) works as an overview to hand over.
filing.software_intro: CSV with form rows (section; row; description; CZK) and the per-lot sales detail for checking.
filing.software_note: UTF-8 with semicolons. EPO cannot load it directly — EPO accepts only XML; the guide is for copying or software that reads CSV.
filing.disclaimer: Indicative guide based on forms {forms}, not tax advice. Check the values before filing.

update.title: Updates
update.subtitle: Application version and how to update it on the server.
update.unknown: Cannot check for a new version
update.err_unavailable: Could not load releases from GitHub (repository {repo}). Checking does not work for a private repository; try again later.
update.err_not_configured: The repository for version checks is not set (update.github_repo in cfg.php).
update.step_backup: Download a database backup before updating — the cron-backup job in Scheduled jobs.
update.docker_hint: In docker-compose.production.yml set the image to version {version} (development versions have no latest tag). Migrations run when the container starts.
update.native_hint: Run the commands as the user that owns the application files. Migrations are idempotent; new scheduled jobs are added by cmd/install.sh (Cron step).
update.manual_only: Updates run on the server — the application cannot change its own files or Docker image.
